questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zone
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right turns are not permitted.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign shows laws that drivers must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads split by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road curves left. Multiple chevron signs may appear throughout a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you should stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: Circular signs mark railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Slow down and be ready for people to cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No parking.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign shows rules drivers must follow. It means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black and alert you to upcoming road hazards. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. They are usually diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has a low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (for example, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit depending on conditions. Bad weather or poor road conditions mean you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass. Stop completely if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves. Slow down and adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway begins.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through this work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells drivers turning left on a green light that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. When posted, it means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work areas ahead. This sign tells you to slow down and drive carefully because there is construction or maintenance work happening.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead where a road will join from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are driving the wrong way on a one-way street. This risks a head-on collision. Carefully turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height of an overpass ahead. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height listed (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Upcoming hill.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming and you should adjust your speed safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers shown on the sign.
